scripts.setup: npm --prefix Frontend-React install && dotnet restore UserApi/UserApi.csproj
scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names frontend,backend --prefix-colors cyan,magenta "npm --prefix Frontend-React run dev" "dotnet watch --project UserApi/UserApi.csproj run"
scripts.build: npm run build:frontend && npm run build:backend
scripts.preview: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names frontend,backend "npm --prefix Frontend-React run preview" "dotnet run --project UserApi/UserApi.csproj"
